summary: transcripts export accepts --file and -o as aliases for the explicit output path, not only --output and --vault.
reason: Agents reach for --file (and the conventional -o shorthand) to name an output path; the generated command only declared --output and --vault, so 'transcripts export <id> --file <path>' aborted with 'unknown flag: --file' before running. A regen must keep --file and -o wired to the same destination as --output, expand a leading ~ on the explicit output path (as --vault already does), and reject --output and --file together rather than silently dropping one.
validated_outcome: transcripts export <id> --file ~/out.md --agent writes the rendered markdown to the tilde-expanded home path (verified against a real synced transcript); passing both --output and --file is rejected; go build/vet/test and verify-skill all pass.
